subject: Key spawn relocation and inactive keys
issue: B1 in HUMAN-DIFFICULTY.md: st_w_04_03 was unclearable for 2..8 players because the key could not be touched.
rootCause: The port placed the key at its authored posX/posY. The original does not: KeyComponent.ParseParameter rewrites the spawn position of the create context in place before the factory reads it back, so the authored anchor is only a starting value and the final position depends on the player count.
callChain: ActorFactoryComponent.CreateActor 0x1816a3351..0x1816a3373 copies the authored posX/posY into createContext+0x28 / +0x30; +0x10 holds the actorCreateParam whose datas[] live at +0x48.
The registered creator runs at 0x1816a3628. For Key that is KeyComponent.Creator 0x18186b470, which calls KeyComponent.ParseParameter at 0x18186b558 with the same context.
Only afterwards does CreateActor read the position back at 0x1816a3658 and hand it to ActorSceneComponent.AddActor 0x1816a3687.

relocation.datas0: pos.x += (playerCount - 2) * datas[0], FP raw, no sar. imul 0x18186bab1, add 0x18186bab5.
relocation.datas1: pos.y += (playerCount * PLAYER_COUNT_SCALE * datas[1]) >> 16. imul 0x18186baea, imul 0x18186baef, sar 0x10 at 0x18186baf3, store 0x18186bb01.
relocation.datas6_7: per-population X / Y offset tables, read at 0x18186b988 and 0x18186b9a4 and applied by the loop at 0x18186bb40..0x18186bbe0.
relocation.playerCount: Frame.GetPlayerIndexCount 0x181749340 - the same source the already-verified population filter uses (ActorFactoryComponent.Update 0x1816a2fe9, population-rules.cjs).

playerCountScale.warning: It is NOT 0.8. Using 0.8 would drift the key by a fraction of a pixel per unit and is exactly the kind of invented constant this project forbids.
derivation: KeyComponent statics are RESOURCE_PATH 0, EXCLUDE_TIME 8, PLAYER_COUNT_SCALE 16, COLLISION_RECT 24 (quantum-field-offsets.json), which exactly fills the 0x38 that KeyComponent..cctor 0x18186d310 writes.
That cctor copies +0x10 from QFP statics+0xc0 (load 0x18186d487, store 0x18186d48e).

Quantum metadata names QFP's 81 FP statics by value; +0xc0 is QFP._0_80. Cross-checked against the same cctor's immediates: +0x70 _0_25 = 0x4000 at 0x181780fde, +0x90 _0_50 = 0x8000, +0xb8 _0_75 = 0xc000 at 0x1817810ff.

QFP..cctor 0x181781124 fills _0_80 with FP.FromString_UNSAFE 0x18163fcb0, which runs Double.Parse then cvtsd2ss (float32 0.800000011920928955) then FP.FromFloat_UNSAFE 0x18163fc40: mulss by 65536.0f (0x182e87660) then cvttss2si, i.e. truncation. 0.8f * 65536 is exactly 52428.80078125, so the raw value is 52428.

inactiveKeys.field: Key slot 2 is m_Inactive (KeyComponent raw +4, il2cpp 20).
inactiveKeys.evidence: ParseParameter 0x18186bbd1 compares the sar'd datas[2] against 0 and 0x18186bbe7 writes 1 when it is positive. InitPost 0x18186bec9 branches on that field and 0x18186bef9 calls setActive 0x18186d170, which turns off both the view (ActorComponent.SetVisible 0x18186d1e4) and the collision (ActorComponent.SetCollisionActive 0x18186d1fc).
inactiveKeys.consequence: An inactive key is not collidable at all until an event re-activates it.

collisionShapeUnchanged: KeyComponent.InitCollision 0x18186bdb0 reads the rectangle from class statics +0x18/+0x28, so the 32x56 box at (-16,-28) is fixed and independent of the slots. Only the anchor moves.
whyOnlyTwoStagesLookedBroken: A survey of all 60 world keys found only st_w_04_03 and st_w_05_03 whose unrelocated box overlapped solid tiles. Six keys carry a non-zero datas[1]: 04_03 (-48), 01_03 (-36), 10_01 (-16), 04_01 (-48), 01_02 (-41), 10_02 (-24). st_w_04_01 carries two keys, one of them with the same -48, and that round was already clearable - which is why 'just shift the key up by datas[1]' was rejected as a hypothesis. The population-scaled rule explains every one of them without special cases.

verification.tileOverlap: No key in any connected round is fully inside solid tiles or below the map any more, for any count 2..8.
verification.compile: 10 rounds x 2..8 players = 70/70 compile, create and run 300 ticks without error.

unresolved: st_w_05_03 also had an overlapping key before this change. It is not a connected round yet, so the fix is not verified there; check it when that stage is connected.
The datas[6]/[7] per-population offset tables are implemented from the loop at 0x18186bb40, but no connected round authors a non-empty table, so that path is untested against real data.
A human has still never cleared st_w_04_03. Compiling and a reachable key are not the same as a clearable round - the electricity below the gap still covers x 48..864.

This agent was cut off by a session limit before writing its own report and before running the old-vs-new regression it had started. The report was reconstructed from its code comments; the compile and behaviour checks above were run independently afterwards.
